keyPoints: 0, 1, 2, 3... se banti hain purn sankhyaen (whole numbers) — prakritik sankhyaon me 0 jodne par ye milti hain.
Sankhya rekha par 0 se dayen badhne par sankhya badhti hai; kisi sankhya ka uttarvarti (successor) usme 1 jodne se aur purvavarti (predecessor) 1 ghatane se milta hai.
Jod aur guna me kram-vinimey gun (commutative): a + b = b + a aur a x b = b x a, jaise 7 + 5 = 5 + 7.
Sahsacharya gun (associative): (a + b) + c = a + (b + c) — jodne ya guna me samooh badalne se parinam nahi badalta.
Vitaran gun (distributive): a x (b + c) = a x b + a x c — jaise 6 x 105 = 6 x 100 + 6 x 5 = 630.
0 jodne par sankhya wahi rehti hai (additive identity) aur 1 se guna karne par wahi rehti hai (multiplicative identity).
Aam galti: ghata aur bhaag me kram-vinimey gun lagana — 8 - 3 aur 3 - 8 barabar nahi hain, isliye inhe ulta karke mat likho.
